answer: The kernel schedule is applied in echo and voyage shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2976 identities would post 3652 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
